design: EmbeddingModelPin fixes model ref, version and digest, tokenizer ref and digest, dimensions (1..4096) and normalization profile (l2-unit only, because vector layouts rank by cosine). EmbeddingModelRegistry resolves a retrieval VectorProfile to exactly one registered pin by its representation version; anything else is UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/EMBEDDING_MODEL_UNPINNED. Model outputs must be finite numbers of exactly the pinned dimensions, representable and non-vanishing at binary32 and unit-norm; every embedding is computed twice and must be identical (EMBEDDING_NONDETERMINISTIC) and the model must still serve its pin (EMBEDDING_MODEL_DRIFT).

EmbeddingDescriptor (LLD v1.1 §2.8.4) binds memory_version_ref, item digest, content digest, partition digest, purpose and marking to the full pin, the representation version, the binary64 embedding digest and the stored binary32 vector digest; its canonical digest is its content-addressed store ref and it is the payload of its index entry. Raw vectors never leave the module or appear in receipts or responses.

EmbeddingLifecycleCoordinator extends the 0051 store coordinator without changing its commits, reads or reconciliation. rebuild(partition_ref, profile) runs under an authenticated binding whose GCS matches the partition tuple (tenant, organization, domain, purpose, policy bundle, ontology release; compartments included; marking dominated) and a permitted live RepresentationPolicy decision on the context bundle; it marks the record BUILDING (compare-and-set), re-embeds every current, ACTIVE, unexpired, undeleted, VECTOR-bearing version in canonical (item, version) order from content read through read_version (committed, projections bound, decrypted and digest-checked), writes each entry to the parallel layout, reads it back (descriptor payload and binary32 digest) and registers the descriptor, sweeps stale descriptors and stray entries, then commits the ACTIVE record with the manifest by compare-and-set against the BUILDING record it wrote and only after that commit writes the success audit receipt (repair 1, VF-002): a lost compare-and-set raises MEMORY_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/REPRESENTATION_RECORD_CONFLICT and leaves the occupant and no success receipt; if the receipt cannot be written the call fails CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE and the record is put back to BUILDING by compare-and-set, retried up to 3 times and stopping when a newer operation owns the record (repair 2). The manifest digest covers lineage, partition, representation version, pin and sorted (version ref, descriptor ref) pairs, never time.

Parallel layouts are keyed by the digest of the parallel lineage and the representation version (ParallelLayout), per partition: distinct from every native layout, so the store coordinator's reconciliation and native pointers never touch them, and there is no cross-compartment collection, centroid or cache.

vector_candidates resolves the profile to a pin first (also for the native path) and checks the query dimensions. Without a parallel record the native path of 0051 answers unchanged. With one: BUILDING fails REPRESENTATION_REBUILDING; another pin fails REPRESENTATION_VERSION_MIXED; any current eligible version without its descriptor fails REPRESENTATION_INCOMPLETE; an entry of another representation version in the layout fails REPRESENTATION_VERSION_MIXED; non-descriptors, foreign, shadow and non-manifest entries are skipped; descriptors of versions no longer current are skipped; a manifest member whose registered descriptor or persisted vector no longer binds fails PROJECTION_DRIFT. Bounded scanning keeps the 0051 UNBOUND_BACKLOG fail-closed bound.

Every refusal of rebuild, invalidate and vector_candidates (repair 1, VF-001) writes a denial event <action>.denied (rebuildEmbeddingRepresentation, invalidateEmbeddingRepresentation, searchEmbeddingRepresentation) with reason and detail code, operation and causation id, correlation id and governed-context digest when a binding exists, partition ref and representation version when known, evaluation time and its canonical audit_ref, never a vector; this covers AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, every GCS/policy refusal (POLICY_DENIED, STALE_POLICY, CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTHORITY_DENIED), REBUILD_INCOMPLETE, record conflicts, REPRESENTATION_ABSENT/REBUILDING/VERSION_MIXED/INCOMPLETE, PROJECTION_DRIFT and query validation. A denial that cannot be audited still fails closed as CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, mirroring the 0052 retrieval service.

Validity window (repair 1, VF-003): descriptors are kept for every current version whatever its valid_from/valid_until (so the representation stays complete when a future version enters its window and a historic valid_at can still be answered), but vector_candidates admits to a candidate slot only versions whose window contains the evaluated instant (valid_from <= t < valid_until, as retrieval), t being the optional keyword valid_at or the boundary clock. Out-of-window entries are skipped like other ineligible ones, so they never displace a valid version; an aware valid_at is required.

Receipt-bound activation (repair 2, VF-001): the ACTIVE record carries the audit_ref of its success receipt (computed before the compare-and-set; ACTIVE <=> manifest_digest and audit_ref set, BUILDING <=> both null; parser closed). vector_candidates and invalidate serve an ACTIVE record only if the audit store (RepresentationAuditSink.contains) holds that audit_ref: absent -> REPRESENTATION_NOT_READY/REPRESENTATION_UNAUDITED, lookup failure -> CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE, both audited as denials. So a record left ACTIVE by a failed withdraw never serves, in this coordinator or in any other over the same stores, until a rebuild writes a receipt; the withdraw remains as best-effort cleanup.

Caller scope of representation lookups (repair 2, VF-002/VF-003): EmbeddingSearchService is the 0052 MemorySearchService (contract and behaviour unchanged) that, for one authenticated search, publishes in a context variable the coordinator it serves, the binding's governed context, the request operation_id and the parsed valid_at. EmbeddingLifecycleCoordinator.vector_candidates uses that scope only when it is its own coordinator's: an omitted valid_at becomes the search's valid_at, and a lookup denial carries correlation_id, operation_id/causation_id and governed_context_digest of the caller (the search service correlates the exception, as in 0052). Outside a search (or for another coordinator) nothing is invented. The scope is reset when the search returns or raises.

invalidate removes descriptors and entries of versions that are no longer current and eligible (revocation, expiry, reclassification, supersession, deletion) and rewrites the manifest with an audit receipt; rebuild performs the same sweep. Metrics use a bounded label set (operation x OK or a Problem reason code).

normative_interpretations: Representation version for retrieval is the 0051 VectorProfile digest (model ref, model digest, dimensions, normalization); tokenizer and model version are bound by the pin and the descriptor, and a representation built under a different pin for the same profile is treated as a mixed version (fail closed) rather than silently reused.

A parallel rebuild covers exactly the current ACTIVE, unexpired, undeleted versions that declared a VECTOR representation at admission; versions that are not ACTIVE are never embedded, and items without a VECTOR representation are not given one by an upgrade.

While a parallel representation of a version exists for a partition, it is the only source of that version's candidates in that partition (one representation per query and partition, no merging of native and parallel layouts); partitions without one keep the native representation.

Representation generation requires a GCS equal to the partition on tenant, organization, domain, purpose, policy bundle and ontology release (stricter than retrieval, which can open cross-domain or compatible purposes with explicit Authority): generation is a write of derived data and has no separate approved cross-boundary profile.

Descriptors and parallel entries are derived, rebuildable data (ADD v1.3 Part II §2.6 indexes are rebuildable projections): a corrupted descriptor row is replaced by the recomputed one during rebuild, never trusted.

requirement_results.command: on real PostgreSQL (metadata, encrypted content, full-text, representation records/descriptors), Qdrant (native and parallel vector layouts) and OpenBao transit: a model upgrade (pinned v1 fixture hash -> pinned v2 feature hashing) builds a parallel representation version of every current ACTIVE vector-bearing version, searched only under its own pin (VECTOR and HYBRID) while the native v1 representation answers byte-identically; every byte of metadata, content, lexical tables, native vectors and head pointers is unchanged; the manifest, descriptors and stored binary32 vectors are identical across repeated rebuilds, fresh adapters and a fresh world with reversed admission order

a Qdrant outage mid-rebuild, a failing audit sink, an acknowledged-but-unwritten index or descriptor write, an unavailable, non-deterministic or drifting model leave the representation BUILDING: retrieval of that version fails closed (REPRESENTATION_REBUILDING) while the native representation is unaffected; resuming converges to the clean manifest; concurrent rebuilds serialise through a compare-and-set record and converge

a vector profile whose model digest, model ref, dimensions or normalization is not exactly a registered pin fails retrieval through the real search service and rebuild with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/EMBEDDING_MODEL_UNPINNED and writes nothing; query vectors and model outputs of other dimensions fail with EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH; a boundary without the v1 pin refuses even the native representation; pins are closed records

a current version embedded only in the old representation (REPRESENTATION_INCOMPLETE), a representation built with another pin for the same profile and an entry of another representation version inside the layout (REPRESENTATION_VERSION_MIXED) fail retrieval instead of mixing versions; a replaced Qdrant vector or an altered descriptor row fails closed (PROJECTION_DRIFT); foreign, shadow and stray entries never occupy a candidate slot; an incremental rebuild restores service

revoked, expired (boundary clock), reclassified and deletion-pending versions never reach a candidate slot, a result, a count or an explanation before any invalidation run; invalidate removes their descriptors and parallel entries with an audit receipt; the reclassified version is embedded only in its own SECRET partition after a rebuild under a SECRET GCS

representation generation requires an authenticated binding and a GCS whose tenant, organization, domain, purpose, policy bundle and ontology release match the partition, whose compartments include it and whose marking dominates it, plus a permitted live policy decision on the context bundle; refusals write nothing; each partition has its own parallel collection and a caller authorized for one compartment searches only that layout

repair 1 (VF-001, VF-002): on real PostgreSQL/Qdrant/OpenBao every refusal of rebuild, invalidate and vector candidate lookup (REPRESENTATION_ABSENT, REPRESENTATION_INCOMPLETE, PROJECTION_DRIFT, REPRESENTATION_VERSION_MIXED; in the unit cases also AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, OPERATION_ID_INVALID, EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH, REPRESENTATION_REBUILDING) appends exactly one <action>.denied event with its reason/detail code and canonical audit_ref and no vector, and an unaudited denial fails closed; a compare-and-set lost to a concurrent occupant after BUILDING (rebuild) or during invalidation leaves the occupant, raises REPRESENTATION_RECORD_CONFLICT and records no success receipt, while the following rebuild records exactly one success receipt and an ACTIVE record; repair 2 (VF-003): inside a search of the EmbeddingSearchService a lookup denial carries the binding's correlation id, the request's operation id as operation and causation id and the governed-context digest; a direct port call outside any search, or a lookup on another coordinator during a search, carries none (nothing invented); without a binding the search fails AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED before any representation lookup

repair 2 (VF-001): on real PostgreSQL/Qdrant/OpenBao, when the success receipt cannot be written and the compensating withdraw compare-and-set fails too, the record left ACTIVE names an audit_ref the audit store does not hold, so the search service, the vector lookup, invalidation and a fresh coordinator over the same stores refuse it (REPRESENTATION_NOT_READY/REPRESENTATION_UNAUDITED, each refusal audited); an unavailable receipt lookup fails CONTROL_PLANE_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE; no success receipt exists until a later rebuild writes exactly one and serves; a withdraw lost to a newer operation leaves that operation's record; a transient withdraw failure is retried within its bound and leaves BUILDING

repair 1 (VF-003): on real backends versions whose valid_until has elapsed or whose valid_from lies in the future never occupy a vector candidate slot nor reach the search response, while an explicit historic valid_at returns the version valid then, also through the search service (repair 2, VF-002: EmbeddingSearchService hands the request's valid_at to the lookup; the elapsed version valid at that instant is returned, the version not yet valid then is absent); the representation keeps their descriptors and stays complete when a future version enters its window (no rebuild); with 140 elapsed versions and one valid version in one partition, a 128-candidate lookup and the real search service return exactly the valid version without error

every embedding descriptor carries the source item's marking and purpose and its partition digest (compartments, marking, purpose, policy bundle, ontology, scope bindings); a reclassified version is never served from the old marking's representation and is embedded only in its own partition; the marking cannot be dropped without changing the descriptor digest and store ref

residual_risks: The embedding models are deterministic governed fixtures (no learned model); semantic quality of embeddings is not claimed. The real embedding worker is a port; its pin must match the registry at every call.

The PostgreSQL representation store and the Qdrant/PostgreSQL adapters are test adapters (0051 adapters plus PostgresRepresentationStore in the task test module); no production adapter under memory/adapters/ exists yet.

Completeness of a parallel representation is checked per query against the metadata authority (one metadata scan of each authorized partition holding a parallel record); this is bounded by PoC volumes, not optimised.

Lifecycle transitions are produced in tests through the ledger port; the lifecycle coordinator is OCOR-DEV-0055 and the deletion saga (which will call invalidate/remove parallel entries) is OCOR-DEV-0056; the deletion saga's acceptance does not name parallel representation descriptors yet.

Backup and restore of representation records and embedding descriptors (repair 1, VF-004): NOT COVERED by any task acceptance in the approved backlog. OCOR-DEV-0058 (promotion to canonical state through C6/C3) does not cover it and the cycle-0 statement attributing it to 0058 is withdrawn; OCOR-DEV-0056 covers deletion propagation and restore honouring tombstones but does not name representation descriptors. Mitigating property, not a closure: records and descriptors are derived data that rebuild() recomputes from the verified source memory and the pin, with a manifest identical across runs, adapters and fresh stores (test_rebuild_is_deterministic_across_runs_adapters_and_fresh_stores), so after a restore of the source stores a rebuild under an authorized GCS reconstructs them; until then vector retrieval of that partition falls back to the native representation (no record) or fails closed (incomplete record). Recorded as an open residual for the G5 integration review.

Composition (repair 2): the historic valid_at and the caller correlation of lookup denials reach EmbeddingLifecycleCoordinator only through EmbeddingSearchService. A caller that composes the plain 0052 MemorySearchService over this coordinator gets the boundary-clock window on the parallel path (false negatives for a historic valid_at, never an over-return: retrieval re-validates every candidate at valid_at) and lookup denials without correlation. No backlog acceptance criterion names this composition and no registered task covers it; there is no production composition root yet (worlds are composed in tests).

Receipt check cost and durability (repair 2): every parallel lookup and invalidation performs one audit-store lookup; the receipt check is as durable as the audit store. In this task the audit store is a test port shared by every coordinator over the same stores (as in cycles 0 and 1, no real audit backend is pinned in infra/services.lock.json); a record left ACTIVE without a receipt stays in the store, non-serving, until the next rebuild.

Out-of-window entries are skipped by bounded scanning: more than max_scanned_hits (256) out-of-window entries ranked above every valid one in one partition fail closed with UNBOUND_BACKLOG instead of answering; filtering inside the index query is not covered by any current acceptance criterion of this task or by a registered task at the time of this record (tracked toward FGM-16).

Test-level anonymous Docker volume leaks in pre-existing suites remain allocated to OCOR-DEV-REM-0018 (see the full-suite resource attribution); the 0053 task suite itself leaves no container, volume or network (task-teardown-delta).
